project_overview.name: Gestão de Stock App (StockFlow)
project_overview.main_goal: A modern, mobile-first, and offline-capable stock management application for SMEs. It transforms smartphones into professional scanners to manage inventory, movements, warehouses, and operator check-ins.
project_overview.architecture: Component-based frontend architecture with Custom Hooks acting as the Controller/Service layer (MVVM-like). Supabase handles remote state and auth, while Dexie handles local offline caching and sync queues.

functional_features: Supabase Authentication & Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Gestor, Caixa)
Mobile-first Scanner (QR & Barcodes) with manual entry fallback
Product CRUD, Warehouse topology, Inventory tracking
Stock movements (in, out, transfer) with FEFO (First-Expire, First-Out) batch support
active_context.recent_updates: Added barcode format validation and fixed UI input bugs for decimal prices and manual quantity entry. Created pitch presentation structure.
active_context.next_steps: Testing the application in real-world scenarios (Pilot), polishing the PWA installation experience, and potentially adding AI-based analytics or ERP integrations.

architectural_decisions.data_access: All Supabase/Dexie calls are encapsulated inside custom hooks (e.g., useProducts.ts, useWarehouses.ts).
architectural_decisions.offline_first: The app prioritizes local Dexie storage when offline. Mutations are queued in a 'pendingOps' table and synchronized when network connectivity is restored (via sync.ts).
architectural_decisions.ui_components: Atomic design pattern for generic UI components (src/components/ui/) such as Input, Button, Badge. Domain-specific components are kept separate (src/components/domain/ or scanner/).
architectural_decisions.error_handling: Handled locally within components using local state (e.g., feedback objects) or global toast notifications (sonner) for user feedback. Graceful degradation when offline.
architectural_decisions.database_security: Heavily reliant on PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) on Supabase. Policies are strictly tied to user roles (via profiles table).

rules_and_constraints.language: TypeScript is mandatory. Avoid 'any' types; strictly type domain entities in src/types/index.ts.
rules_and_constraints.styling: Use Tailwind CSS utility classes exclusively. Use the custom 'cn' utility function from formatters.ts to merge conditional classes dynamically.

naming_conventions.database: snake_case for tables, columns, and remote types

rules_and_constraints.forbidden_practices: Do not execute direct Supabase mutations inside UI components; always use or create a function in the corresponding custom hook. Do not bypass RLS policies; test functionality across different user roles.
rules_and_constraints.linters: ESLint is configured. Ensure code passes 'npm run lint'.

environment_and_setup.tests: No formal testing suite (Jest/Vitest) detected in package.json. Testing is currently manual.
